svg.title: VIRA System Architecture
svg.desc: End-to-end VIRA architecture: clients, API and edge, kernel runtime, agent platform, intelligence and memory, tools and extensions, persistence, and deployment operations.

g.text: Local-first AI runtime · client, kernel, agents, tools, knowledge, data and operations
Live tool traces · runtime context rail
SSE event stream · NDJSON chat stream
• User data stays on the machine by default.
• Local Ollama is preferred before remote LLMs.
• Collector consent is explicit and revocable.
• Payloads and secrets are encrypted at rest.
• Account export and delete are first-class.
• All tool calls are authorized and audited.
From one local process to a fleet
Event lag · failed events · queue depth
Alerts for expiry, backlog and failures
Authenticated ingress · multi-user · multi-device · durable streams
The local runtime: state, sensors, scheduling, security and durability
Durable reasoning, tool use, delegation and replayable execution
Agent registry · metadata + versioning · capability discovery
Event router · runtime scheduler · re-entrant concurrency
Intent → recall lessons → context → tool loop → answer
Tool catalog · relevance ranking · dynamic tool_search
Specialist definitions · delegation with fresh context
Step persistence · replay · resume · cancel · events
User context · consent · devices · health · focus
Local-first models, scoped memory, retrieval and human insight
Capability discovery and extension points, all permissioned and audited
SQLite by default · PostgreSQL adapter · every domain is scoped and migratable
VIRA · local-first AI runtime · see docs/SERVER_ROADMAP.md, docs/PLUGIN_SDK.md and docs/P4_ECOSYSTEM.md
